items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.title_zh: 谷歌推出Gemini 3.8 Flash与网络安全版3.8 Flash Cyber
items.title_en: Google Introduces Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber Security Model
items.summary: Google announces Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber, a new fast, low-cost model with strong coding and benchmark performance.

items.title: Muse Spark 1.3
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.3，以低成本刷新软件工程基准纪录
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 Tops Software Engineering Benchmark at Low Cost
items.summary: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 is a new, highly cost-effective AI model that pushes toward state-of-the-art performance on software engineering benchmarks.

items.title: Google avoids a breakup of its ad tech business
items.title_zh: 谷歌广告科技业务免于被法院强制拆分
items.title_en: Google Avoids Court-Ordered Breakup of Ad Tech Business
items.summary: Google avoids a court-ordered breakup of its ad tech business, though the DOJ wins some remedies, reflecting a major moment in tech antitrust enforcement.

items.title: Three sites made 215,128 “best software” pages for AI. Perplexity cites them
items.title_zh: 报告揭露三个网站制造21.5万AI引用“最佳软件”页面
items.title_en: Report Exposes Three Sites' 215,128 AI-Cited 'Best Software' Pages
items.summary: A report exposes how three sites generated hundreds of thousands of 'best software' pages that are now cited by AI systems like Perplexity, highlighting the feedback loop of low-quality manufactured content influencing AI responses.

items.title: Can I opt out of my input or output data being used for training?
items.title_zh: Mistral 默认将用户数据用于训练引发隐私担忧
items.title_en: Mistral's Default Opt-In Data Training Draws Privacy Concerns
items.summary: A Hacker News discussion critiques Mistral's default opt-in data training policy, reflecting broader user concerns about privacy and trust in AI companies.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.1 发布，基准大涨；Willison 用鹈鹕图测试
items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 released with strong benchmarks; Willison runs pelican test
items.summary: Simon Willison reacts to Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 launch, noting its strong benchmark scores and playfully evaluating its 'pelican' capabilities.

items.title: Most open-source AI detectors can't hold a 0.5% false-positive rate [P]
items.title_zh: 开源AI检测器多数无法达到0.5%误报率，并存在偏见
items.title_en: Open-source AI detectors fail 0.5% false-positive test and show bias
items.summary: An evaluation of open-source AI detectors shows most cannot maintain a 0.5% false-positive rate, perform poorly on paraphrased text, and exhibit bias against non-native writers.

items.title: ♻️ 英伟达发布 DLSS 5 神经渲染，9 月 3 日随 NBA 2K27 上线
items.title_zh: 英伟达发布搭载 3D 引导神经渲染的 DLSS 5，9 月 3 日上线
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, Launching Sept 3
items.summary: NVIDIA announces DLSS 5 with 3D-guided neural rendering, launching September 3 alongside NBA 2K27 for RTX 50 series and GeForce NOW Ultimate.

items.title: 🤖 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Max-0902，CodeArena 编程榜 1691 分夺冠
items.title_zh: 阿里发布Qwen3.8-Max-0902，CodeArena编程榜1691分夺冠
items.title_en: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max-0902 tops CodeArena with 1691, undercuts rivals
items.summary: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Max-0902, a 2.4T-parameter LLM with 1M context that tops the CodeArena leaderboard (1691) and offers cheaper API pricing than rival models.

items.title: ♻️ 英伟达洽购 Hugging Face，估值超 130 亿美元  据知情人士透露，英伟达近期与开源 AI 平台 Hugging Face 进行收购洽谈，交易
items.title_zh: 英伟达洽谈收购 Hugging Face，估值超 130 亿美元
items.title_en: Nvidia in Talks to Acquire Hugging Face for Over $13 Billion
items.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to acquire open-source AI platform Hugging Face at a valuation exceeding $13 billion.

items.title: 🌙 月之暗面与三大云巨头谈判，寻求 Kimi K3 最高 30% 分成
items.title_zh: 月之暗面与三大云巨头谈判，寻求 Kimi K3 最高 30% 分成
items.title_en: Moonshot AI seeks up to 30% revenue share from US cloud giants for Kimi K3
items.summary: Moonshot AI is in early talks with Microsoft, AWS, and Google for up to 30% revenue sharing on its open-source 2.8T-parameter Kimi K3 model, which would be the first major deal of its kind between a Chinese AI company and US cloud giants.

items.title: 🤖 xAI 发布 Grok 4.6，聚焦长时间运行的智能体任务  xAI 于 2026 年 8 月 12 日发布 Grok 4.6，在 Grok 4.5 基础上
items.title_zh: xAI 发布 Grok 4.6，聚焦长时智能体任务并追平 GPT-5.6 Sol
items.title_en: xAI Launches Grok 4.6 for Long-Running Agent Tasks, Matching GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary: xAI releases Grok 4.6, focusing on long-running agent tasks and vision, achieving benchmark parity with GPT-5.6 Sol and now available across Cursor, Grok Build, and API.

items.title: Nexus 暗网兜售 1.53 亿张驾照扫描件，FBI 已介入调查
items.title_zh: FBI调查Nexus暗网售卖1.53亿张驾照扫描件
items.title_en: FBI Probes Nexus Dark Web Service Selling 153M Driver's License Scans
items.summary: FBI is investigating Nexus, a dark web service claiming to sell 153 million scanned driver's licenses from US and Canadian residents.
